# Visual Audit: LCC website v1 (live at baswet.github.io/lcc-nakuru-website, 25 Nov 2026)

**Stack:** static HTML generated by `tools/build.py` from `data/content.json`; vanilla JS; self-hosted fonts; PHP admin and forms for PHP hosting.
**Backup:** `lcc-v1-backup-20261125.zip`, plus the GitHub history (commit "Add LCC Nakuru website pages…").
**Before screenshots:** `research/before-v1-screenshots/`.

| Area | Finding | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| Design system (ivory, Fraunces, clay; night bands) | Distinctive and accessible (0 axe issues) | **Retain** and extend |
| Home hero | Placeholder gradient art; reads as unfinished | **Redesign:** real LCC worship stills from YouTube, linked to their services, plus a "This Sunday" panel |
| Facts strip / intent tiles | Useful | **Retain** and refine |
| About | Three plain cards; history placeholder | **Redesign** fully: 13-section storytelling page |
| Mission / vision | Hidden in ordinary text | **Redesign** as oversized typographic moments |
| Core values | Missing (now verified from the conference site) | **Add** |
| Leadership | One card; bio not sourced | **Improve:** official biography from cuttingedgeconference.co.ke/about |
| Ministries | Equal cards, same layout as elsewhere | **Redesign:** image-led discovery plus dedicated sections |
| Services / programmes | "To be confirmed" only | **Improve:** confirmed First and Second Sunday Services and Praise Express (streams); times still to be confirmed |
| Sermons | One flat grid of 34 | **Redesign:** streaming-style rows, speaker filter, latest services |
| Events | One event row | **Redesign:** featured conference, upcoming vs past archive, countdown, past events (Leaders' Summit 2026, Pastors' and Spouses Conference, CEC 2026, Crossover Kesha) |
| Conference page | Good base | **Improve** into a "universe": anchor scripture, countdown, 2027 speakers, all-time featured speakers, 2026 archive |
| Gallery | Missing | **Add:** "LCC Moments" with lightbox (YouTube stills now; approved photos later) |
| Watch live | Link only | **Add:** a Watch page with latest services; no false "live" indicator |
| Share | Missing | **Add:** native share and copy-link |
| Forms / admin | Secure and tested | **Retain**; extend admin with photo-slot approval |
| Repetition | Many pages share hero + cards | **Fix:** each page gets its own treatment |
